title: Medical Billing Specialist
summary: Medical billing specialists make sure US hospitals and clinics get paid by insurers, by entering charges, posting payments and chasing unpaid or denied claims (accounts receivable, or AR). They sit in revenue cycle teams at Indian healthcare outsourcing firms, often on US night shifts.
dailyDuties: Call US insurance payers to follow up on unpaid claims
Analyse denied claims and send corrected claims or appeals
Enter charges and submit claims through the clearinghouse
Post payments and read EOBs and ERAs for underpayments
Verify patient eligibility and benefits before visits
Update claim notes in the practice management system
Report daily AR and collections to the team lead

skills.expectation: Follow up with US insurance payers on unpaid and pending claims
Work denials, find the root cause and file corrected claims or appeals
Enter charges and submit clean claims on CMS-1500 or UB-04
Post payments and read EOBs and ERAs for underpayments
Verify patient eligibility, benefits and prior authorisation
Know Medicare, Medicaid and commercial payer rules and filing limits
Work claims in a practice management or billing system
Handle patient health information under HIPAA rules
Speak clear English on US-shift calls with payer representatives
Read CPT and HCPCS codes on claims to spot coding denials
Read diagnosis codes on claims to spot coding denials
Prepare daily AR and collections reports
Use spreadsheets for AR ageing and reconciliation

certifications.why: Shows spreadsheet skill for AR ageing and posting reports
